basic_profile.bio: PixelKnight_92 is a 31-year-old graphic designer based in Portland, Oregon. Passionate about digital art and gaming, they spend their free time diving into fantasy RPGs like Dark Souls and creating intricate digital wallpapers. Known for their love of vibrant colors and intricate designs, they frequently share their work on Reddit and other art communities. They are single and enjoy the flexibility of freelance work, which allows them to manage their time and indulge in late-night gaming sessions. Typically online in the evenings and early mornings, they are a night owl by nature.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: PixelKnight_92 has a background in digital art and design, having studied graphic design at a local college. Their expertise in design software like Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator has been honed over years of both formal education and self-directed learning. They are an avid gamer with extensive knowledge of RPGs, particularly the Dark Souls series, which they have played extensively.
